headline: Bitcoin is back near $83K after oil spiked above $110, and Solana switches on its biggest upgrade yet today.

stories.title: Bitcoin climbs back near $83K after an oil scare. ETFs had their biggest inflow in a month
stories.summary: Oil jumped above $110 on Tuesday as attacks in the Middle East continued, and Bitcoin dipped to about $81.2K. By early Wednesday it was back above $82.7K. On Monday, US spot Bitcoin ETFs took in their biggest one-day inflow in a month.
points: Monday 19 Oct: US spot Bitcoin ETFs took in about $527M net ($526.6M per CoinDesk; $526.7M per CoinGlass via Yahoo Finance). BlackRock's IBIT alone took in $665.2M.
Ether ETFs lost $103.3M on 19 Oct, their fourth straight day of outflows.
Brent oil went above $111 a barrel on 20 Oct, its highest since May. Bitcoin dipped to roughly $81,200 the same day.
The Fed decides on rates on 28 Oct. CoinDesk says it is widely expected to hold.

stories.title: Solana switches on Alpenglow today, its biggest upgrade so far
stories.summary: Solana is replacing the way its validators vote on blocks. The goal is for transactions to become final in about 150 milliseconds instead of about 12.8 seconds. Holders and wallet users don't need to do anything.
points: Solana's official page says Alpenglow activates in epoch 1064, starting about 13:20 UTC on Wed 21 Oct (about 20:20 Bangkok). Crowdfund Insider said near 15:00 UTC.
Target finality is about 150 milliseconds, down from about 12.8 seconds.
Fees and transaction formats don't change. Ordinary users need no action.
Vote transactions leave the blocks, so transaction-count charts will show lower numbers. That is a counting change, not less use.

stories.title: Utah sues prediction market Kalshi, calling its bets illegal gambling
stories.summary: Utah's attorney general sued Kalshi on 20 Oct, saying its sports and event contracts break the state's gambling ban. Kalshi says it is a federally regulated exchange. It is part of a growing fight between states and federal rules over who may use these markets.
points: The suit was filed in Utah's 3rd District Court on Tue 20 Oct.
Utah estimates Kalshi collected roughly $30.6M to $61.2M in fees from Utah accounts as of 19 Oct, and wants that money returned.
Kalshi says it is "a federally regulated financial exchange, like the stock market" and that no single state should have a veto over it.
The outcome affects which US states can use prediction markets.

briefs.title: SEC comment window on its crypto rule has closed
briefs.summary: The comment period for the proposed 'Regulation of Crypto Assets' ended 20 Oct after about 140 submissions. The SEC now begins a months-long review.

briefs.title: Zcash (ZEC) up 11% after its next upgrade got a date
briefs.summary: Developers set the activation height for NU7, which cuts block times from 75 to 25 seconds.

briefs.title: Kazakhstan court restricts Coinbase and five other exchanges
briefs.summary: The AIFC Court barred Coinbase, BingX, Bitcoin.com, HTX, BitMart and WEEX from serving AIFC users without a licence.

briefs.title: Stablecoins now move over $400M an hour
briefs.summary: A Coinbase and The Block study put adjusted stablecoin volume at $891B in Q3 2026. About 73% of transfers happen outside US banking hours.

briefs.title: CFTC says CME can't challenge US perpetual futures
briefs.summary: The regulator argued in court that CME has only claimed more competition, not real harm, and asked for the suit to be dismissed.

briefs.title: MoonPay and Upbit owner Dunamu explore a stablecoin payments tie-up
briefs.summary: The two firms say they will explore working together on stablecoin-based global payments and wider access to Dunamu's Ethereum layer-2 network, GIWA.

briefs.title: BNB treasury company BNB Standard rings the Nasdaq bell on 26 Oct
briefs.summary: The company, formerly CEA Industries, has a new CEO, Alex Odagiu, from 19 Oct.

briefs.title: Akedo (AKE) token unlock today
briefs.summary: About $64.7M of AKE unlocks on 21 Oct, about 9.35% of circulating supply, per KuCoin. It is a small-cap token.
